B.feature: z512 only; no K, AIS, port, world_xy, Y, density or support
B.fit_pool: source-fit P0 image-valid objects, labelled and unlabelled; cap 2000/port by sample_id hash
B.source_cal_target_action: transform and nearest frozen centroid only
B.scope: T: each product scene; G: aggregate target adapt only, freeze retained bank for target eval

D.density_provenance: E00 dedup/offshore leave-one-out counts; if counts were calculated before offshore filtering, recompute this column only

J_definition: J1: same data; hash halfA port weight x3, others x1
J2: same data; hash halfB port weight x3, others x1
J.model: conditional moment regressor, not target label posterior
J.unestimable_cell_policy: disable that D globally across J unless a separately declared pooled shrinkage model is used; do not fill zero

calibration.calibration_input: calibration-port adapt products, label-blind P0 pool and same masks
calibration.unavailable_policy: do not tune target; B1 + calibration_unavailable
calibration.uncertainty_claim: empirical held-out-port tolerance, not 90/95% distribution-free coverage
calibration.relation_mechanism_shared_scope: one J for all active groups within the decision scope
